@Gideon Sato: Your first report was at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, in this channel: "gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant," with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.

In the meantime, the channel shows the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. At 11:03 Mateo reported kiosk 1 was back and that the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. You reported both lanes working at 11:08 (as of 11:07).
